verdict.rationale: Llama is a family of open-weight models plus a download and verification CLI, not a data-holding application. The story assumes a product that stores the user's data and layers AI insights on top of it, which does not fit a model distribution. The model is the AI engine that other products embed, so asking whether it surfaces insights from your data inside the product is a category error. None of the evidence shows a first-party app where users keep their own data and receive AI suggestions.
